title: AI labs are buying data from dead startups to train their models
summary: AI labs are creating a secondary market for data from defunct startups, with companies monetizing previously worthless digital archives for model training. One founder netted approximately $25,000 selling his crypto startup's codebase and user data, illustrating how AI's data hunger is transforming failed ventures into revenue opportunities.
content: When Keelan Miskell began winding down his crypto startup this year, he didn’t think its data was worth much: the users were anonymous, the company just a few years old.
